**Initialization:** Reserve a virtual address range of size $V_{init}$ using VMM APIs.
**Committing Memory (Add Splats):** When splats are added, calculate the required physical memory $P_{req}$.
**Expansion (Out of Virtual Capacity):** If $P_{req}$ exceeds the currently reserved virtual range, reserve a larger virtual address range.
